description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachment entity class in a PHP project using Doctrine ORM. It models employee attachment data such as description, filename, attachment content, file type, related employee, and metadata like attached time and who attached. It also includes constants for different screen contexts where attachments might be used.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's attachment, with properties for attachment details, metadata, and related employee. Uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping. Supports attachment-related operations and validation.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this attachment.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the attachment's identifier.

methods.name: setAttachId
methods.description: Sets the attachment's identifier.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the attachment content or resource.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets the attachment content.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen context where the attachment is used.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen context for the attachment, validating against allowed screens.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedByName
methods.description: Sets the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the attachment was made.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the attachment was made.
